title: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no circuit of AND, OR (fan-in two) and NOT gates with at most 15 gates computes its edge function
unlocks: Gives the value 16 for the Petersen graph minus a vertex, the piece the restriction route to the Petersen graph at 20 gates needs; a fleet seat is proving that row now.
context: SKETCH: no proof is expected here: propose a cut: by first gates up to symmetry, by a structural invariant, by cases. this row is proved by assembling cases on the circuit's first gate, each case its own desk step (no circuit of at most 15 gates with that first gate, by a SAT certificate replayed in Lean); the graph has 12 automorphisms, so 14 pair and NOT cases plus constant and copy first gates cover everything (routes/lgp/own/filing/petersen/SKETCH.md). Take a case step, not this row, until the cases are checked. Size of the assembly: about 30 minutes once the cases are in.
